children: Healthcare Triangle entered into a First Amendment to its Equity Purchase Agreement with Hudson Global Ventures to modify the company’s equity line facility. The amendment reduces the maximum amount per put notice to $250,000, raises the minimum share price to $0.10, and adds a change-of-control provision that halts further puts upon such an event. Certain definitions were updated, while all other terms of the June 12, 2026 agreement remain in effect.
: First Amendment to Equity Purchase Agreement (equity line financing)
: Refine equity line terms and protect pricing
